research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free mathematical prerequisite audit; contextual specialization checked against original source-indexed reference decisions; no new meanings, original edits, gate approval, or certification.

aliases.reason: In the syntomic-ring-map source the fibre algebra S⊗_R κ(p) is the exact base-change commutative R′-algebra construction S⊗_R R′ used in the universal-homeomorphism source, specialized to the R-algebra R′=κ(p). Tensor multiplication, unit and scalar structure agree. Residue field, local complete intersection, flatness and quantification over prime p belong solely to the syntomic parent.

The topological pointwise-convergence source uses the function set T^D={f:D→T}, canonically identical to the set-theoretic Cartesian product ∏_{d∈D}T of a constant indexed family. The product-topology source defines the general indexed Cartesian product ∏_{i∈I}X_i. Topological convergence and coordinate projections are additional parent-specific constructions, not attributes of a bare product set.

The two-category-over-base source defines 2-morphisms as natural transformations between functors over C with components mapping to identity arrows in C. The categories-fibred-in-sets and -setoids sources use the same exact over-base natural transformation, with each component projecting to id_{p(x)}. The separate object types of the total categories remain parent-specific, and no equivalence of the 2-categories is asserted.

For an affine open U in a scheme S, global sections of the restricted structure sheaf O_U have ring Γ(U,O_U)=O_S(U) by the definition of sheaf restriction. The reduced-scheme sectionwise source uses O_X(U) for precisely the same sheaf-section ring construction. Affineness of U and the scheme-cardinality supremum are parent-only restrictions, and neither expression means a stalk.

The separably-generated-extension source's k(B), with B a potentially infinite transcendence basis over k, is a rational-function field in algebraically independent indeterminates B. The purely-transcendental-extension source's k(X_i:i∈I) is the fraction field of the polynomial algebra in an arbitrary indexed independent family, allowing finite expression support. Relabel b↔X_b to obtain the same k-field construction; separability of the subsequent extension and existence of a basis remain source-specific.
